scope: One independent test-seed episode per configuration, all 18/18. Observed completion-time improvement only; no statistical reliability or generalization claim. Learned residual, DLS-only and rule all preserve the original scoring/physics.
learned_component: Only the six-axis DLS residual; perception, IK planning, waypoint logic, grasp/release FSM and gripper remain analytic/rule-based.

phase_attribution.interpretation: Observed difference is mainly less PLACE phase waiting/tracking time, not evidence that all movements are uniformly faster. Other motion/hold differences offset part of the 10.90-second PLACE reduction.

terminal_release_boundary.interpretation: All three results satisfy the original 18/18 termination. The student terminates during PLACE with a closed-jaw command; this experiment did not separately verify that all objects remain stably in the basket after fully opening the jaws.
